title: Center for Western Studies at Augustana University Names New Leader
summary_en: The Center for Western Studies (CWS) at Augustana University has named Dr. Jon K. Lauck as its next executive director. He is only the center’s fourth leader since its founding by author and Augustana Professor Emeritus of English Dr. Herbert Krause in 1964.
